correctness.rationale: The four-state orientation generator is explicitly diagonalized; the degree-four chiral witness follows by four complex polynomial stationarity equations, and the positive square covariance by an invertible four-by-four moment recurrence through degree four. Brownian thermal convolution preserves both connected statistics and the independence boundary. Normalizations were independently checked against 1024 deterministic standard-library generator calculations over positive parameter grids, including zero and nonzero translational diffusivity. Finite checks support, not replace, the analytic algebra.

value.rationale: The equal-rate model owes its exact 2D solution to factorization; the theorem classifies exactly when that structural simplification survives biased quarter turns. It also finds the least polynomial degree at which *static* positional data can distinguish the direction of chiral bias, and proves insensitivity of that raw fourth signal to independent thermal Brownian noise. These are nontrivial boundaries for a natural nearest-turn physical model rather than arbitrary parameter slices or a recomputation of the equal-rate law.
